exampleEn: I can't believe he decided to back out at the last minute.
exampleKo: 그가 막판에 빠지기로 결정했다니 믿을 수 없다.
gameExamples: She promised to join us for the trip, but she chose to back out when she heard the weather forecast.
It's really disappointing that I had to back out of the meeting because of a family emergency.
He wanted to participate in the event, but he had to back out due to a scheduling conflict.
